Done. Summary:

- **`out/T2/solution.py`**: plain `torch` + `safetensors` script that slices head 5 out of `c_attn.weight`/`c_attn.bias` (column blocks across the fused q|k|v segments) and `c_proj.weight` (row blocks), leaves everything else untouched, and asserts all required shapes/tensor counts before writing.
- **`out/T2/run.sh`**: runs it via the repo's `.venv`.
- **`out/T2/model.safetensors`**: output, 160 tensors, verified bit-exact against manual index slicing and correct final shapes (`[768,2112]`, `[2112]`, `[704,768]`).
- **`out/T2/REPORT.md`**: participant self-report, including the finding that `transformers` `prune_heads` (suggested in `F-allowed.md`) doesn't actually exist for GPT-2 in the pinned transformers 5.12.1, so I used plain slicing instead.

One execution, first-try success, no failures.
